scientific_integrity: The leading spectral asymptotic already appears in the initial 2021 preprint, and classical Bessel/hypergeometric identities are prior work. The new claim is the explicit second coefficient and unique cancellation scale. Finite numerical tests corroborate but cannot certify an infinite asymptotic.
scientific_limitations: Assumes fixed d>=2, alpha>0, mu>(d+1)/2+alpha+2 and eps>0. Only second-order high-degree eigenvalue asymptotics; no finite-mode optimality, uniform-parameter bounds, or extension to boundary mu=lambda+2. Independent mathematical audit not performed.
title: The second-order spherical Wendland spectrum and its unique scale cancellation
